decisions.decision: Unblock T-033 and build it now. Don't wait for T-031/T-032. Code against a DayOutput interface ({attendeeId, day, url, pdfUrl}) and use a stub output for now. Write cloud/src/jobs-delivery.ts. It runs on each delivered output and calls POST /email-campaigns/:id/contacts on one Tantra Omnichannel 'Day output' campaign per day, using the same import helper as T-234. Each contact carries customFields {output_link, output_pdf} plus email and whatsappPhone. Keep a delivered(attendee, day) ledger in D1 so a second tick never sends twice. Before choosing a send path, grep the Tantra backend code graph for how step templates fill in customFields. If {{customFields.output_link}} renders, use Tantra for both email and WhatsApp. If not, send the email through Resend and keep WhatsApp on Tantra. Run it end to end against [email] ('Adi test'), and add a probe that checks idempotency and finds no Twilio, n8n or SendGrid calls. Once T-031/T-032 are in, swap the stub for the real output and move the task to review.
decisions.why: T-031 and T-032 are only build dependencies, so the delivery code can be written now behind an interface. integrations-tantra-api.md §5 shows the add-contacts route accepts customFields. The send model comes from google-and-reminder-model (2026-10-07), and orchestrator-autonomy says build end to end.

decisions.decision: Build the delivery code now. Don't wait for T-031/T-032. Code it against the ops.db day_outputs contract in workshop-plan/ops/runbook.md. 1) Create one Tantra campaign per day, 'Day N Output Ready', with an email step and a WhatsApp step, plus merge fields {{firstName}}, customFields output_url_dayN and output_pdf_dayN. Copy follows COPY_RULES.md, no dashes. 2) In scheduled(), take each new delivered day_outputs row for a non-test, non-revoked attendee. Claim a D1 row keyed (attendee, day) before the call. Then POST /email-campaigns/<id>/contacts with the fields, through the same import helper as T-234. 3) Add a Resend email fallback behind a flag in case Tantra merge of customFields fails in the live check. 4) Add the route to vendor-sim.py and write app/scripts/probe-output-delivery.mjs (one send, a second tick adds nobody, grep finds no Twilio/n8n/SendGrid). Commit and push. The live 10-minute test with [email] runs after the T-337 key and T-031/T-032 land.
decisions.why: T-234's spec already uses Tantra customFields merge for per-contact links, so the same import route covers this (google-and-reminder-model, 2026-10-07). The blockers are build order, not Adi inputs. The only live input is the key, already asked in T-337.

decisions.decision: Clear the two stale blockers: T-031 and T-032 are both in review. Swap the stub DayOutput for the real T-032 source (attendee_outputs, /o/<token> and /o/<token>.pdf) in cloud/src/jobs-delivery.ts and workshop-plan/ops/deliver.py. Rerun probe-day-delivery.mjs and probe-tantra-reminders, and fix the evidence label to 26/26. Deploy the Worker and push. Run dryrun_day1.py against the simulator so T-034 can move. Move the WhatsApp connect and test-number ask to its own small input task linked to T-337, and remove it from this task's ask. Leave T-033 waiting only on those two inputs. Once the key and number are in: create the 3 Day-output campaigns, run the Day 1 test send to the Adi test identity only, confirm email and WhatsApp arrive within 10 minutes with no duplicate on the next tick, then move to review.
